dolly_in.prompt: A lighthouse at dusk. The camera dollies in toward the subject on a smooth track, parallax shifting in the background, moving at a steady pace. The camera travels forward on its track and arrives at a close view of the subject, the lens height unchanged.

notes: quick mode: one still and a camera instruction, no anchor stills
dolly_in_quick.prompt: A lighthouse at dusk. The camera dollies in toward the subject on a smooth track, parallax shifting in the background, moving at a steady pace. The camera travels forward on its track and arrives at a close view of the subject, the lens height unchanged.

orbit_180_one_pass.prompt: A bottle. The camera orbits 180 degrees around the subject at constant distance, the subject staying centred while the background rotates behind it, moving at a steady pace. The camera circles halfway round at the same distance and height and ends behind the subject, who stays centred and facing the same way.

anchors.edit_prompt: Same scene, subject, wardrobe, lighting and style as the reference. The camera has orbited 90 degrees around the subject to its right, seeing it in profile.
Same scene, subject, wardrobe, lighting and style as the reference. The camera has orbited 180 degrees around the subject, now seeing it from behind.

notes: one pass: 3 middle stills guided inside the shot
orbit_360.prompt: A bottle. The camera makes a full 360 degree orbit around the subject at constant distance, the subject staying centred while the background rotates behind it, moving at a steady pace. The camera circles all the way round at the same distance and height and ends where it began, the subject centred throughout.

static.prompt: A lighthouse at dusk. The camera is locked off on a tripod; only the subject moves. The frame stays perfectly still from the first moment to the last; only the subject moves.

anchors.edit_prompt: Set the scene ablaze: flames spreading across the ground and surfaces, smoke and embers in the air, everything lit by orange firelight.

notes: transformation (ignite): the last still is edited into the end state and LTX renders the change
static_ignite.prompt: A lighthouse at dusk. The camera is locked off on a tripod; only the subject moves. The frame stays perfectly still from the first moment to the last; only the subject moves. Flames catch at the edges of the frame and spread across the scene, embers drifting upward and the light turning orange, until fire fills the shot, the crackle of the fire rising.
